name: Low-Carb Steak Fajita Skillet
fit_evidence: Published 517 cal (within 400-650) and 7g carbs (<=35); seared sliced steak + peppers + cheese skillet weighs-and-divides cleanly to 14 servings; no seafood.
dupe_evidence: Closest catalog recipe is steak-fajita-rice-bowls (sirloin/peppers/onions/RICE/sour cream) - same steak+fajita flavor but that is a rice bowl; this is the no-rice cheese-finished low-carb skillet (no rice, adds shredded cheese, skirt/flank), the distinct plate this low-carb run targets. Not a dupe.
cross_protein_collisions: A low-carb chicken fajita skillet would be the structural twin (catalog has fajita-chicken-rice-bowl / creamy-chicken-fajita-burrito, both rice/burrito not low-carb skillet).
A low-carb turkey fajita skillet twin (catalog has turkey-fajita-rice-bowls, a rice bowl) - decider should watch other-protein pools for a no-rice fajita skillet.
notes: Genuine unmapped flag on skirt/flank steak cut (board tracks sirloin/ribeye/chuck) - wanted pricer-lane exercise, not a penalty.
